name: Gym Membership Inquiry
place: A modern fitness center front desk
speaker: Consultant

tasks.goal: Greet the consultant and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the consultant and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Inquire about monthly membership plans and contract terms
tasks.hint: Ask for pricing options and contract commitments.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about gym membership plans and pricing.

tasks.goal: Ask about gym operating hours on weekends and holidays
tasks.hint: Inquire when the facility opens and closes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about gym operating hours.

tasks.goal: Request a guided tour of weight room and cardio equipment
tasks.hint: Ask to see fitness equipment before joining.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a tour of the gym facility.
tasks.scene_hint: Clinking weight plates and hum of treadmills fill the spacious gym floor.

tasks.goal: Inquire about personal trainer availability and session rates
tasks.hint: Ask if individual coaching is offered.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about personal training sessions and costs.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'locker'
tasks.hint: Locker is a storage cabinet. Ask if locker rental is included.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'locker'.

tasks.goal: Ask if group fitness classes like yoga or spin are included
tasks.hint: Inquire about group class schedule and fees.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about group fitness classes.

tasks.goal: Negotiate waiving initiation sign-up fee during promo period
tasks.hint: Ask if enrollment fees can be waived.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated waiving initiation sign-up fees.

tasks.goal: Ask about guest pass policy for bringing friends
tasks.hint: Inquire how many guest passes are allowed per month.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about guest pass rules.

tasks.goal: Address issue regarding crowded peak hours and pool maintenance
tasks.hint: Express concern over equipment waiting times.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about peak hour crowding and facility maintenance.
tasks.scene_hint: Scent of disinfectant and fresh towels greets visitors near the sauna entry.

tasks.goal: Ask if membership can be paused during vacation travel
tasks.hint: Inquire about freezing account status temporarily.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about membership freeze policy.

tasks.goal: Confirm cancellation notice period requirements
tasks.hint: Ask how many days notice is required to cancel membership.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed membership cancellation terms.

tasks.goal: Request a complimentary trial pass before committing
tasks.hint: Ask for a one-day guest pass to test the facility.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a free trial pass.

tasks.goal: Confirm payment billing method for monthly auto-pay
tasks.hint: Verify direct debit or card billing details.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed billing method for membership fees.

tasks.goal: Thank the consultant and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the consultant AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Inquire if discounted membership rates are available for students or seniors
tasks.hint: Ask if student or senior citizen ID qualifies for reduced monthly dues.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about student or senior membership discount rates.

tasks.goal: Specify fitness goals such as weight loss or muscle building
tasks.hint: State primary fitness objectives to gym representative.
tasks.done_when: Learner specified personal fitness goals.

tasks.goal: Inquire about parking availability and designated member parking spaces
tasks.hint: Ask if the gym facility provides free parking for members.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about member parking availability and validation.

tasks.goal: Inquire about advance notice requirement for cancelling membership
tasks.hint: Ask how many days written notice is required to cancel.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about cancellation notice period requirements.

tasks.goal: Confirm procedure for freezing membership during extended travel
tasks.hint: Ask if account can be paused while on vacation.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed membership freeze options for travel.

tasks.goal: Verify locker rental pricing for permanent monthly storage
tasks.hint: Ask cost of renting dedicated personal locker long-term.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified monthly locker rental pricing.

tasks.goal: Request complimentary day pass trial for a friend
tasks.hint: Ask if guest pass can be issued for workout partner.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested guest trial pass for friend.

tasks.goal: Verify key fob digital access card replacement fee
tasks.hint: Ask cost of replacing lost entrance scanner key tag.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified key fob replacement fee.

tasks.goal: Confirm location of emergency first aid and defibrillator equipment
tasks.hint: Ask staff where safety equipment is located in facility.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed emergency equipment locations in gym.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'orientation'
tasks.hint: Orientation is intro session. Ask if new member equipment orientation is offered.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'orientation'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'enrollment'
tasks.hint: Enrollment is sign-up process. Ask if enrollment sign-up fee can be waived.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'enrollment'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'amenities'
tasks.hint: Amenities are facility features. Ask about premium amenities like sauna.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'amenities'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'regimen'
tasks.hint: A regimen is a prescribed course of exercise or diet. Ask for assistance designing a personalized fitness regimen.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'regimen'.

tasks.goal: Inquire about group fitness class schedules like yoga or spin
tasks.hint: Ask what group exercise classes are included in membership.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about group fitness class schedule and types.

tasks.goal: Ask if gym provides certified personal training trial session
tasks.hint: Inquire if new members receive complimentary coaching session.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about free personal training trial session.

tasks.goal: Report broken cable on lat pulldown machine in weight room
tasks.hint: Inform gym staff of damaged equipment cable.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported broken cable on weight machine.

tasks.goal: Request tour of free weight area and cardio machine zone
tasks.hint: Ask staff to walk through gym facilities before signing.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested facility walkthrough tour.
tasks.scene_hint: Thud of heavy barbells hitting rubber flooring in weight room.

tasks.goal: Ask for clarification regarding annual facility maintenance fee
tasks.hint: Inquire why separate maintenance charge is billed once a year.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about annual facility maintenance fee details.

tasks.goal: Inquire if gym access card works across all nationwide locations
tasks.hint: Ask if membership allows entry to branch facilities in other cities.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about multi-location gym access privileges.

tasks.goal: Report out-of-order treadmill screen in cardio bay
tasks.hint: Point out dark display screen on running machine.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported malfunctioning treadmill display screen.
tasks.scene_hint: Rhythmic hum of treadmills and whir of stationary bikes.

tasks.goal: Ask if towel service is included or requires extra fee
tasks.hint: Inquire if workout and shower towels are provided free.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about gym towel service availability and cost.

tasks.goal: Request assistance adjusting seat height on exercise bike
tasks.hint: Ask instructor how to set proper saddle position on bike.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested help adjusting exercise bike seat height.

tasks.goal: Inquire about swimming pool lap lane reservation rules
tasks.hint: Ask if lap swimming requires booking time slots online.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about swimming pool lane reservation policies.

tasks.goal: Ask for instructions on operating digital locker locks
tasks.hint: Ask staff how to program electronic keypad on locker.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for instructions on setting locker PIN.
tasks.scene_hint: Smell of fresh eucalyptus towel steam near sauna entrance.

tasks.goal: Clarify policy on age restrictions for teenage gym members
tasks.hint: Ask if teenagers under 16 require adult supervision.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about youth membership age restrictions.

tasks.goal: Inquire if gym offers body composition scanner analysis
tasks.hint: Ask if InBody scanner measurements are available for members.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about body composition scanner testing.

tasks.goal: Ask if water refill fountain provides filtered cold water
tasks.hint: Verify location of bottle filling stations on gym floor.
tasks.done_when: Learner located filtered water bottle refill station.

tasks.goal: Request lower music volume in free weight workout area
tasks.hint: Politely ask desk staff if loudspeaker volume can be reduced.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested lower music volume in weight room.
tasks.scene_hint: Cling of weight plates being loaded onto Olympic barbells.

tasks.goal: Inquire about nutrition consultation and meal planning advice
tasks.hint: Ask if gym has registered dietitian on staff for advice.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about nutrition consultation services.

tasks.goal: Report slippery floor near swimming pool shower entrance
tasks.hint: Inform staff of puddle hazard on tiled walkway.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported slippery floor hazard near pool.

tasks.goal: Confirm whether sauna and steam room operating hours match gym times
tasks.hint: Ask if spa facilities close earlier than main gym floor.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified sauna and steam room operating hours.
tasks.scene_hint: Bright LED lighting illuminating racks of dumbbells sorted by weight.

tasks.goal: Ask if gym allows bringing personal boxing gloves and wraps
tasks.hint: Inquire about equipment rules for heavy bag combat area.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about personal gear rules in boxing zone.

tasks.goal: Request price discount for upfront annual membership payment
tasks.hint: Negotiate lower rate for paying full year in single sum.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested discount for lump-sum annual payment.

tasks.goal: Inquire about corporate employee wellness discount partnerships
tasks.hint: Ask if employer list qualifies for monthly fee discount.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about corporate wellness discount eligibility.

tasks.goal: Ask if member account can be transferred to another person
tasks.hint: Inquire if contract can be reassigned if moving abroad.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about membership transferability to third party.

tasks.goal: Report missing pin on selectorized leg press machine
tasks.hint: Inform staff that weight stack adjustment pin is missing.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported missing weight stack selector pin.
tasks.scene_hint: Upbeat dance music pumping rhythmically through ceiling speakers.

tasks.goal: Ask for recommendation on low-impact exercise for knee recovery
tasks.hint: Inquire which cardio machines are safest for joint rehab.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for low-impact exercise recommendations.

tasks.goal: Request key to handicap accessible private shower booth
tasks.hint: Ask front desk for keycard access to accessible shower.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested access to accessible private shower.
tasks.scene_hint: Rows of clean chrome shower stalls with frosted glass doors.

tasks.goal: Confirm whether guest passes renew monthly under premium plan
tasks.hint: Ask how many guest passes are credited per month.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified monthly guest pass allowance terms.

tasks.goal: Ask if gym offers childcare daycare services while working out
tasks.hint: Inquire if supervised kids play area is available on site.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about on-site childcare service options.

tasks.goal: Inquire about personal trainer cancellation notice timeframe
tasks.hint: Ask how many hours before session cancellation must be logged.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about personal training session cancellation rules.

tasks.goal: Report unhygienic un-wiped bench in dumbbell section
tasks.hint: Inform staff that workout bench was left sweaty by previous user.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported uncleaned workout bench.
tasks.scene_hint: Spray bottles of disinfectant and paper towel dispensers stationed around floor.

tasks.goal: Ask if gym contract auto-renews after initial twelve months
tasks.hint: Check if membership rolls over automatically unless cancelled.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about contract auto-renewal terms.

tasks.goal: Inquire about outdoor turf functional training zone
tasks.hint: Ask if outdoor workout area is open during winter months.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about outdoor functional training turf access.

tasks.goal: Request extra disinfectant wipe for cleaning weight bench
tasks.hint: Ask staff for fresh paper towel and sanitizing spray.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested cleaning wipes for gym equipment.
tasks.scene_hint: Digital clock timer counting down intervals on wall in HIIT studio.

tasks.goal: Ask about policy on filming or photography inside locker rooms
tasks.hint: Inquire strict rules regarding mobile phone camera usage in gym.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about privacy rules regarding cameras in gym.

tasks.goal: Clarify procedure for upgrading from basic to VIP all-access pass
tasks.hint: Ask how to upgrade tier and when new dues take effect.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about membership tier upgrade procedures.

tasks.goal: Inquire about heart rate monitor strap connectivity with cardio machines
tasks.hint: Ask if treadmills sync with Bluetooth heart rate chest straps.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about heart rate monitor device syncing.

tasks.goal: Report cold water temperature in shower stalls
tasks.hint: Inform front desk that shower water is not heating up.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported cold shower water temperature.
tasks.scene_hint: Rows of shiny lockers with built-in digital combination keypads.

tasks.goal: Ask if gym carries protein shakes and energy bars at juice bar
tasks.hint: Inquire menu options at front desk smoothie bar.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about protein shakes sold at juice bar.

tasks.goal: Request guidance on proper deadlift form from floor trainer
tasks.hint: Ask roaming trainer to inspect lifting posture for safety.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested deadlift form check from floor coach.

tasks.goal: Inquire about stretch recovery zone foam rollers and massage guns
tasks.hint: Ask where mobility equipment and recovery tools are kept.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about recovery tools like foam rollers.

tasks.goal: Ask if gym membership fee can be paid via automatic bank debit
tasks.hint: Inquire if direct debit from checking account is supported.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about direct debit bank payment options.

tasks.goal: Request assistance locating misplaced water bottle left near bench
tasks.hint: Ask front desk lost-and-found for misplaced item.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired at desk for misplaced water bottle.
